### In Deed and Truth
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/deed-and-truth
Passage: 1 John 3:16-18
Points:
- Jesus provides the ultimate definition of love by laying down His life for us.
- While believers do not atone for sin, they are called to sacrifice selflessly for other Christians.
- Love typically proves itself through concrete deeds of mercy rather than literal martyrdom.
- Affluent believers must guard against materialism and actively share resources with brothers and sisters in need.

### Compassion Is Love in Action
Author: Meg Bucher
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/compassion-is-love-in-action-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: 1 John 3:18
Points:
- True compassion goes beyond good intentions and enters deeply into the suffering of others.
- Christlike love requires stepping out in vulnerability and investing personal time, emotions, and resources.
- Words and digital messages cannot replace tangible, in-person presence and care.
- The indwelling Holy Spirit supplies the strength to practice real love that brings joy and healing.

### Actions Speak Louder Than Words
Author: Leslie Snyder
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/homeword-june-19-2009-11604958.html
Passage: 1 John 3:18
Points:
- Genuine Christian love is validated by tangible actions rather than mere verbal profession.
- Quiet, deliberate acts of care often communicate truth far more persuasively than spoken words.
- Disciples are called to function as Christ's hands and feet in daily relationships.
- Living out love visibly can revive struggling believers and draw them back into fellowship.

### The Good Samaritan
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/the-good-samaritan-today-s-insight-may-25-2019.html
Passage: 1 John 3:16-17
Points:
- Intellectual grasp of biblical commands is empty without practical obedience.
- Christ set the standard of love by sacrificing His life, calling believers to self-sacrificial living.
- Clinging to material comforts while ignoring a brother in distress contradicts having the love of God.
- Believers must beware of being so absorbed in religious words that they overlook real needs around them.
